dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、早く来すぎたか……」
dialogues.en: "I'm a bit early today..."
dialogues.text: "I'm a bit early today..."

dialogues.jp: 音楽室はしんと静まり返り、人の気配もない。
dialogues.en: There was no indication of any life around the music room.
dialogues.text: There was no indication of any life around the music room.

dialogues.jp:
「何で、俺みたいな奴が、眠たいの我慢してま
　でこんな……」
dialogues.en: "I should've just slept a bit later today..."
dialogues.text: "I should've just slept a bit later today..."

dialogues.jp:
壁に背中をもたせかけ、思わず苦笑いを浮かべ
てしまった。
dialogues.en: I leaned back onto the wall and waited for the other three.
dialogues.text: I leaned back onto the wall and waited for the other three.

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「おはようです〜」
dialogues.en: "Morning~"
dialogues.text: "Morning~"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「あ、おはよ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, morning."
dialogues.text: "Ah, morning."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ことりはまだなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Kotori hasn't arrived yet?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Kotori hasn't arrived yet?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
みっくんは、廊下の前後に目をやった。学生の
姿がちらほら見える。
dialogues.en:
Mik-kun looked at the corridor a little nervously. I could
see a few students mingling about.
dialogues.text:
Mik-kun looked at the corridor a little nervously. I could
see a few students mingling about.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「あの……｛き／訊｝いてもいいです？」
dialogues.en: "Uhm... can I ask you something?"
dialogues.text: "Uhm... can I ask you something?"

dialogues.jp:
首を伸ばすようにして廊下の向こうまで見遣っ
てから、みっくんはこちらを向いた。
dialogues.en:
Taking a last glance at the corridor, she turned back to
face me.
dialogues.text:
Taking a last glance at the corridor, she turned back to
face me.

dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「ふたりは、もうキスとかもしちゃってるよう
　な関係なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Have the two of you kissed yet?"
dialogues.text: "Have the two of you kissed yet?"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「みっくん……」
dialogues.en: "Mik-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Mik-kun..."

dialogues.jp:
たしなめるように呼びかけるが、みっくんは、
まあまあなどと取り合わない。
dialogues.en:
Tomo-chan chided Mik-kun with a gentle voice, but didn't do
much more to stop her.
dialogues.text:
Tomo-chan chided Mik-kun with a gentle voice, but didn't do
much more to stop her.

dialogues.jp: 「あ〜と……ふたりって？」
dialogues.en: "Uhm... the two?"
dialogues.text: "Uhm... the two?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ことりと、朝倉君です」
dialogues.en: "Kotori and you."
dialogues.text: "Kotori and you."

dialogues.jp: にこにこと笑いながら、きっぱりと言い切る。
dialogues.en: Smiling, she said it plain as day.
dialogues.text: Smiling, she said it plain as day.

dialogues.jp: 「……いやあ、ただの友達だけど」
dialogues.en: "...No, we're just normal friends."
dialogues.text: "...No, we're just normal friends."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「何だ、そうなんですか。残念ですね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, that's how it is? Too bad."
dialogues.text: "Oh, that's how it is? Too bad."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「ことりが特定の男子と一緒に居るなんて初め
　てだから、そうなのかなって思ったんですけ
　ど」
dialogues.en:
"This is the first time Kotori's been so close to a guy, so
I just thought that it was closer than it seemed."
dialogues.text:
"This is the first time Kotori's been so close to a guy, so
I just thought that it was closer than it seemed."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君。どうか、ことりと仲良くしてあげて
　下さいね」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, please treat Kotori well."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, please treat Kotori well."

dialogues.jp:
ぺこりと頭を下げる。浮かべた笑顔とは裏腹に、
どうも本気らしかった。
dialogues.en:
She bowed her head respectfully, but the smile on her face
made me unsure how serious it was.
dialogues.text:
She bowed her head respectfully, but the smile on her face
made me unsure how serious it was.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ……もちろんだけど」
dialogues.en: "A, ahh... of course."
dialogues.text: "A, ahh... of course."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「ほ、ほんとに……ほんとですか？」
dialogues.en: "Y, you... you really would?"
dialogues.text: "Y, you... you really would?"

dialogues.jp: 不意にともちゃんが口を開いた。
dialogues.en: Tomo-chan suddenly interrupted us.
dialogues.text: Tomo-chan suddenly interrupted us.

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君……ほんとに、ことりと仲良くしてく
　れますか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun... you would treat her well?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun... you would treat her well?"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、ほんとに」
dialogues.en: "Definitely..."
dialogues.text: "Definitely..."

dialogues.jp: 切なげに顔を曇らせ、ともちゃんは言った。
dialogues.en: Tomo-chan continued with a clouded expresison.
dialogues.text: Tomo-chan continued with a clouded expresison.

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「ことりは寂しがり屋だから……気になってし
　まうんです」
dialogues.en:
"Kotori seems rather lonely lately... we've been worried
about that."
dialogues.text:
"Kotori seems rather lonely lately... we've been worried
about that."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「でも、大丈夫ですよね。朝倉君とことりなら」
dialogues.en: "But it'd be alright. Asakura-kun with Kotori, I mean."
dialogues.text: "But it'd be alright. Asakura-kun with Kotori, I mean."

dialogues.jp:
ともちゃんよりは楽観的らしいみっくんは、そ
う言って話を締めくくった。
dialogues.en:
Tomo-chan, seeing Mik-kun's optimistic outlook, easily gave
in.
dialogues.text:
Tomo-chan, seeing Mik-kun's optimistic outlook, easily gave
in.

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「遅いですね……」
dialogues.en: "She's really late..."
dialogues.text: "She's really late..."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「つっても、まだ１０分だぜ？」
dialogues.en: "Shall we wait 10 more minutes?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we wait 10 more minutes?"

dialogues.jp:
携帯電話のディスプレイをみながら、俺はそう
言った。
dialogues.en:
I looked at the screen of my cellphone as I made a
suggestion.
dialogues.text:
I looked at the screen of my cellphone as I made a
suggestion.

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「そうですけど……ことりは滅多に遅刻しない
　んです」
dialogues.en:
"I guess... but Kotori isn't one to be late in the first
place..."
dialogues.text:
"I guess... but Kotori isn't one to be late in the first
place..."

dialogues.jp: お互いに首を傾げた。
dialogues.en: I nodded in agreement.
dialogues.text: I nodded in agreement.

dialogues.jp: さらに１０分。
dialogues.en: 10 minutes had passed.
dialogues.text: 10 minutes had passed.

dialogues.jp: 廊下の先に、待ち人が現れた。
dialogues.en: The latecomer had finally arrived.
dialogues.text: The latecomer had finally arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「やほ〜……ごほっ、ごほっ……遅れて……え
　ほっ……ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en:
"Hey... *cough cough*... sorry... *cough cough*... for being
late."
dialogues.text:
"Hey... *cough cough*... sorry... *cough cough*... for being
late."

dialogues.jp:
咳で何度か中断されながらも、何とかそれだけ
口にした。
dialogues.en:
Constantly interrupted by coughs, it was hard to tell
exactly what she said.
dialogues.text:
Constantly interrupted by coughs, it was hard to tell
exactly what she said.

dialogues.jp: 「お、おいおい、ことり、大丈夫かよ？」
dialogues.en: "O, oy oy, Kotori, are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "O, oy oy, Kotori, are you okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だ──ごほっ、げほっ、えほっ……」
dialogues.en: "I'm fi-- *cough, cough, cough...*"
dialogues.text: "I'm fi-- *cough, cough, cough...*"

dialogues.jp:
身体を折って激しく咳き込む。そうしながら、
にょきっとＶサインを差し上げた。
dialogues.en:
Her body essentially answered for her with a series of
violent coughs, but she still gave a weak v-sign.
dialogues.text:
Her body essentially answered for her with a series of
violent coughs, but she still gave a weak v-sign.

dialogues.jp: 「けど、そんなんじゃ、とても歌なんて……」
dialogues.en: "But both ways, how are you going to sing like that...?"
dialogues.text: "But both ways, how are you going to sing like that...?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりの頭上で、３人の視線が絡まる。と、みっ
くんが、ことりの背中を撫でながら言った。
dialogues.en:
The three of us surrounded Kotori, who was leaning over
slightly from coughing. Mik-kun gently stroked her back and
admonished her.
dialogues.text:
The three of us surrounded Kotori, who was leaning over
slightly from coughing. Mik-kun gently stroked her back and
admonished her.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「もう……心配した通りになっちゃったじゃな
　い」
dialogues.en: "Geez... I guess I was right to be worried."
dialogues.text: "Geez... I guess I was right to be worried."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「え？　心配って？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Worried?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Worried?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、この前言ってたじゃないですか。日曜
　は、ライブに行くって……」
dialogues.en:
"Remember what I said a few days ago? About the concert on
Sunday..."
dialogues.text:
"Remember what I said a few days ago? About the concert on
Sunday..."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「ああ……じゃ、それで風邪をぶり返したって
　わけか」
dialogues.en: "Ahh... so that's probably why the cold has returned."
dialogues.text: "Ahh... so that's probably why the cold has returned."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜……ご、ごめん。げほっ、えほっ！」
dialogues.en: "Uu~... I, I'm sorry. *cough cough!*"
dialogues.text: "Uu~... I, I'm sorry. *cough cough!*"

dialogues.jp:
ぺこんと頭を下げ、そのままの姿勢で、激しい
咳に肩を震わせた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori bowed her head in apology, and at the same time, her
shoulders trembled in sync with her constant coughs.
dialogues.text:
Kotori bowed her head in apology, and at the same time, her
shoulders trembled in sync with her constant coughs.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「ともかく今日は休んだ方がいいよ。それじゃ、
　練習にならないと思うし……」
dialogues.en:
"In any case, you should take it easy today. We can't
practice in this state..."
dialogues.text:
"In any case, you should take it easy today. We can't
practice in this state..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごほっ、ごほっ、げほっ！」
dialogues.en: "*cough, cough, cough!*"
dialogues.text: "*cough, cough, cough!*"

dialogues.jp:
咳をしながら激しく首を振る。みっくんはそれ
に取り合わず、俺に顔を向けた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori tried to shake her head no at Mik-kun's assertion,
but she ignored her and turned to face me.
dialogues.text:
Kotori tried to shake her head no at Mik-kun's assertion,
but she ignored her and turned to face me.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君、ことりを家まで送ってもらえますか」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, Could you make sure Kotori gets home safely?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, Could you make sure Kotori gets home safely?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そりゃ構わないけど」
dialogues.en: "Aahh, no problem with me."
dialogues.text: "Aahh, no problem with me."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「お願いします。私達も、後でお見舞いに行く
　から。ね、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Please. We'd visit you later, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Please. We'd visit you later, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「無理するのは良くないと思うよ。……ことり
　も、分かってるでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "It's not good to push yourself so hard, okay, Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "It's not good to push yourself so hard, okay, Kotori?"

dialogues.jp:
しばらく咳を続けていたが、やがてことりは、
こくんとうなずいた。
dialogues.en:
The coughs continued thick and fast, but Kotori managed to
get a small nod in between.
dialogues.text:
The coughs continued thick and fast, but Kotori managed to
get a small nod in between.

dialogues.jp:
それを合図に、みっくんは音楽室の分厚い扉を
あけた。
dialogues.en:
At that signal, Mik-kun entered the music room through the
large entrance.
dialogues.text:
At that signal, Mik-kun entered the music room through the
large entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「私達は、いつもの時間まで練習します。それ
　が終わったら、お家に行くからね」
dialogues.en:
"Since we've already reserved the place, we'd practice here
till it's over. We'd visit after then."
dialogues.text:
"Since we've already reserved the place, we'd practice here
till it's over. We'd visit after then."

dialogues.jp:
俺とことりとそれぞれに呼びかけて、みっくん
はそっと扉を閉めた。
dialogues.en: After telling us that, they disappeared into the music room.
dialogues.text: After telling us that, they disappeared into the music room.

dialogues.jp: 「そんじゃ、行こうか」
dialogues.en: "Let's go now."
dialogues.text: "Let's go now."

dialogues.jp: 寄り添うようにして、廊下を逆に｛たど／辿｝り始めた。
dialogues.en:
Letting Kotori lean on my shoulder, we started the long
route back to her house.
dialogues.text:
Letting Kotori lean on my shoulder, we started the long
route back to her house.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う〜……迷惑を掛けてしまいました」
dialogues.en: "Uu~... I'm such a bother, aren't I..."
dialogues.text: "Uu~... I'm such a bother, aren't I..."

dialogues.jp:
ふらふらとおぼつかない足取りで、ことりは｛うめ／呻｝
くように呟いた。
dialogues.en: Kotori managed to moan that out in between her coughs."
dialogues.text: Kotori managed to moan that out in between her coughs."

dialogues.jp:
「ま、今は余計な事は考えずに、身体を治す事
　が先決だろ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't think about that too much, just concentrate on
getting better."
dialogues.text:
"Don't think about that too much, just concentrate on
getting better."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうかもしれないですけど……ごほっ……は
　あ、はあ……」
dialogues.en: "I can't just do that... *cough cough*"
dialogues.text: "I can't just do that... *cough cough*"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうしても、ごほっ……考えちゃうんです…」
dialogues.en: "I'm always... *cough* thinking about that..."
dialogues.text: "I'm always... *cough* thinking about that..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、別に、誰も迷惑だなんて思っちゃいな
　い」
dialogues.en:
"Then don't think you're being a bother to anyone, including
me."
dialogues.text:
"Then don't think you're being a bother to anyone, including
me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「げほっ、ごほっ……」
dialogues.en: "*cough cough...*"
dialogues.text: "*cough cough...*"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "O, okay..."
dialogues.text: "O, okay..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「半分は怒って……半分は心配してくれていま
　す……」
dialogues.en: "I guess you're half worried... and half angry."
dialogues.text: "I guess you're half worried... and half angry."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん、まあ、そんな感じだろうな」
dialogues.en: "Well, something like that."
dialogues.text: "Well, something like that."

dialogues.jp:
ゆらゆらと揺れる身体が気がかりで、さりげな
く背中に手を置いた。
dialogues.en:
She was still moving unsteadily, so I placed my hand on her
back.
dialogues.text:
She was still moving unsteadily, so I placed my hand on her
back.

dialogues.jp:
自分の手が大きく見えるような錯覚を与える、
小さな背中。
dialogues.en:
It seemed like an illusion, my hand which looked so big, on
her back which looked so small.
dialogues.text:
It seemed like an illusion, my hand which looked so big, on
her back which looked so small.

dialogues.jp: 心配だった。
dialogues.en: Of course I was worried.
dialogues.text: Of course I was worried.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君……ごほっ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun... *cough*"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun... *cough*"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
呼びかけの後、咳が続く。俺はそっと、背中を
撫でさすった。
dialogues.en:
"Before she could finish her sentence, another series of
coughs took over. I started rubbing her back.
dialogues.text:
"Before she could finish her sentence, another series of
coughs took over. I started rubbing her back.

dialogues.jp:
咳が治まり、荒い息が続く。その合間を見計ら
うようにして、ことりが言った。
dialogues.en:
After the coughs settled, she took a long, rough breath. She
then finished her sentence.
dialogues.text:
After the coughs settled, she took a long, rough breath. She
then finished her sentence.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何の何の」
dialogues.en: "It's nothing, don't worry."
dialogues.text: "It's nothing, don't worry."

dialogues.jp:
亀のように緩やかな歩みで、ようやくここまで
やって来た。
dialogues.en:
Walking at a turtle's pace, we finally reached the area
which Kotori lived in.
dialogues.text:
Walking at a turtle's pace, we finally reached the area
which Kotori lived in.

dialogues.jp:
こんな調子で学園まで歩いてきたから、それで、
時間に遅れてしまったのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Considering her condition now and how far she had to walk to
get to school, no wonder she was late.
dialogues.text:
Considering her condition now and how far she had to walk to
get to school, no wonder she was late.

dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫か？　あと、どのくらい？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay? How long more from here?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay? How long more from here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あと……少しです」
dialogues.en: "Just... a bit more."
dialogues.text: "Just... a bit more."

dialogues.jp:
ほとんど｛しょうすい／憔悴｝とも言える表情を向け、弱い笑み
を浮かべる。くっと、胸が痛んだ。
dialogues.en:
She said with a haggard voice, looking at me tiredly with a
weak smile. It made my heart ache.
dialogues.text:
She said with a haggard voice, looking at me tiredly with a
weak smile. It made my heart ache.

dialogues.en: "...Sorry."
dialogues.text: "...Sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「一旦家に引き返すとかして、チャリに乗っけ
　た方が良かったな。歩かせるのは良くなかっ
　た」
dialogues.en:
"If I knew the route to your house, we could've gotten there
a lot faster..."
dialogues.text:
"If I knew the route to your house, we could've gotten there
a lot faster..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……ううん……ごほっ……こっちの方が、良
　かったんですよ……」
dialogues.en:
"...No... *cough*... I'm sort of glad that you don't know
it..."
dialogues.text:
"...No... *cough*... I'm sort of glad that you don't know
it..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だって、その分、長く一緒に居られるじゃな
　いですか……」
dialogues.en: "Because I can stay with you a bit longer..."
dialogues.text: "Because I can stay with you a bit longer..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりはくすっと笑った──ように思う。それ
が、咳じゃなければ。
dialogues.en:
Kotori gave me her usual sweet smile-- that definitely
wasn't a cough from my imagination.
dialogues.text:
Kotori gave me her usual sweet smile-- that definitely
wasn't a cough from my imagination.

dialogues.jp:
……いや、今はそれを気にしてる場合じゃない。
ことりを早く家に連れていかなければ。
dialogues.en:
...No, this is no time to be thinking about something like
that. I have to get Kotori to her home as fast as possible.
dialogues.text:
...No, this is no time to be thinking about something like
that. I have to get Kotori to her home as fast as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Kotori...?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori...?"

dialogues.jp: 前から少し呆然とした声が聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: I heard a surprised voice in front of us.
dialogues.text: I heard a surprised voice in front of us.

dialogues.jp: 「工藤……どうしてここに」
dialogues.en: "Kudou... why are you here?"
dialogues.text: "Kudou... why are you here?"

dialogues.jp:
ここは散歩で来るような場所じゃない。何か明
確な目的を持たなければ来ない場所だ。
dialogues.en:
This isn't a place someone would go just to walk around. You
wouldn't come here unless you had a reason to.
dialogues.text:
This isn't a place someone would go just to walk around. You
wouldn't come here unless you had a reason to.

dialogues.jp: じゃあ、工藤がここに来た明確な目的は……？
dialogues.en: Then, the reason why Kudou came here was...?
dialogues.text: Then, the reason why Kudou came here was...?

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「オレ、この近所に住んでるんだよ。……あれ？
　知らなかったっけ？」
dialogues.en: "I live in this neighbourhood... you didn't know?"
dialogues.text: "I live in this neighbourhood... you didn't know?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……そうだったっけ？」
dialogues.en: "...Really?"
dialogues.text: "...Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ああ……って、そんなこと話してる場合じゃ
　ないよな。ことり、どうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah... but this isn't the time to talk about that. Kotori,
what's wrong?"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah... but this isn't the time to talk about that. Kotori,
what's wrong?"

dialogues.jp:
工藤が駆け寄ってきて、一緒にことりを支えて
くれる。
dialogues.en: Kudou rushed to Kotori's other side to prop her up.
dialogues.text: Kudou rushed to Kotori's other side to prop her up.

dialogues.jp:
「昨日、ライブに行って、風邪をぶり返したら
　しいんだ」
dialogues.en:
"She went to a concert yesterday, and she exerted herself
too much, so her cold returned."
dialogues.text:
"She went to a concert yesterday, and she exerted herself
too much, so her cold returned."

dialogues.jp: 俺が簡単に説明する。
dialogues.en: I gave a quick and dirty explanation.
dialogues.text: I gave a quick and dirty explanation.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は頷いて、心配そうな顔をことりにそっと
寄せた。
dialogues.en:
Kudou nodded at me, then returned his worried gaze to
Kotori.
dialogues.text:
Kudou nodded at me, then returned his worried gaze to
Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「本当にそれだけか？　ことり」
dialogues.en: "Is that really all that is, Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Is that really all that is, Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん、それだけ。大丈夫だよ。工藤君が心配
　するようなことはないから」
dialogues.en:
"Uh huh, that's all. It's okay. You don't have to be so
worried."
dialogues.text:
"Uh huh, that's all. It's okay. You don't have to be so
worried."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ならいいんだけど……」
dialogues.en: "If you say so..."
dialogues.text: "If you say so..."

dialogues.jp: ふたりの間で、言葉少なに交わされる会話。
dialogues.en: The two of them were just exchanging small talk.
dialogues.text: The two of them were just exchanging small talk.

dialogues.jp:
たったそれだけで何かを分かり合えてしまうの
だと思ったら、俺の中の何かが痛んだ。
dialogues.en:
Yet even though I knew that, something inside me was hurting
at seeing them do that.
dialogues.text:
Yet even though I knew that, something inside me was hurting
at seeing them do that.

dialogues.jp: （……何が痛いんだ？）
dialogues.en: "(...Why is it painful?)"
dialogues.text: "(...Why is it painful?)"

dialogues.jp: 自分のことなのに訳が分からない。
dialogues.en: I don't even understand myself now.
dialogues.text: I don't even understand myself now.

dialogues.jp: 俺はひたすら歩き続け──。
dialogues.en: I decided to just keep walking--
dialogues.text: I decided to just keep walking--

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……おいおい、朝倉、どこ行くんだよ？」
dialogues.en: "...Oyoy, Asakura, where're you going?"
dialogues.text: "...Oyoy, Asakura, where're you going?"

dialogues.jp: 工藤が急に立ち止まった。
dialogues.en: Kudou had come to a stop.
dialogues.text: Kudou had come to a stop.

dialogues.jp: 「どこって……ことりの家に決まってるだろ」
dialogues.en: "Where... to Kotori's house, obviously."
dialogues.text: "Where... to Kotori's house, obviously."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ことりの家ならここだよ」
dialogues.en: "Kotori's house is here."
dialogues.text: "Kotori's house is here."

dialogues.jp: そう言って工藤が一軒の家を目線で示す。
dialogues.en: Kudou pointed her house to me with his eyes.
dialogues.text: Kudou pointed her house to me with his eyes.

dialogues.jp: 工藤の態度はごく自然で。
dialogues.en: His own reaction was very natural for him.
dialogues.text: His own reaction was very natural for him.

dialogues.jp:
別に偉そうな態度だったり、自慢したりする態
度ではなかったが。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't detect one ounce of self-importance or
belittlment from his attitude.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't detect one ounce of self-importance or
belittlment from his attitude.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ことりの家すら知らなかったんだと思い
知らされたような気がした。
dialogues.en:
He was just worried that I honestly didn't know where
Kotori's house was.
dialogues.text:
He was just worried that I honestly didn't know where
Kotori's house was.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……じゃ、後は朝倉に任せたよ」
dialogues.en: "...Anyway, I'd leave the rest to you."
dialogues.text: "...Anyway, I'd leave the rest to you."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あ……おい、何だよそれ」
dialogues.en: "Ah... oy, what do you mean by that."
dialogues.text: "Ah... oy, what do you mean by that."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「オレ、馬に蹴られて死ぬほど無粋じゃないん
　だよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm smart enough to know when I'd be in the way."
dialogues.text: "I'm smart enough to know when I'd be in the way."

dialogues.jp: 笑いながらそう言った工藤が見たのはことりで。
dialogues.en: Kudou laughed a bit and looked at Kotori.
dialogues.text: Kudou laughed a bit and looked at Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「痛そうですからね」
dialogues.en: "Even though it hurts?"
dialogues.text: "Even though it hurts?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりも苦いものを混ぜながらも、笑顔を浮か
べた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's words had a tinge of bitterness, yet her returned
smile didn't reflect them.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's words had a tinge of bitterness, yet her returned
smile didn't reflect them.

dialogues.jp: 工藤が、じゃ、と手をあげて去っていく。
dialogues.en: Kudou then let go of Kotori.
dialogues.text: Kudou then let go of Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
（あー……なんだ、この訳の分からんモヤモヤ
　は）
dialogues.en:
"(Ah~ Why do they keep talking about things I don't
understand.)"
dialogues.text:
"(Ah~ Why do they keep talking about things I don't
understand.)"

dialogues.jp: 考えても結論は出せそうもなかった。
dialogues.en: I couldn't think of any logical conclusion in my head.
dialogues.text: I couldn't think of any logical conclusion in my head.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うっ……けほっ」
dialogues.en: "Uu... *cough*"
dialogues.text: "Uu... *cough*"

dialogues.jp:
何より、今はそんなことを考えている場合じゃ
なかった。
dialogues.en: Anyway, no time to think about that now.
dialogues.text: Anyway, no time to think about that now.

dialogues.jp: ことりを休ませるのが最優先だ。
dialogues.en: Kotori's rest comes first.
dialogues.text: Kotori's rest comes first.

dialogues.jp: 「お邪魔します……って、入ってもいいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me... eh, is it okay for me to go in?"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me... eh, is it okay for me to go in?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いいんです」
dialogues.en: "It's alright."
dialogues.text: "It's alright."

dialogues.jp:
お気楽に答えることりだが、ほんとにいいんだ
ろうか？
dialogues.en: Kotori answered so easily, is it really alright?
dialogues.text: Kotori answered so easily, is it really alright?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あれ……？　誰か、居るのかな……？」
dialogues.en: "Huh...? Someone's in...?"
dialogues.text: "Huh...? Someone's in...?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりが首を傾げる。家の奥から音楽が聞こえ
てくるのだ。クラシック？
dialogues.en:
Kotori tilted her head slightly. The house was filled with
the sound of music. Classical music?
dialogues.text:
Kotori tilted her head slightly. The house was filled with
the sound of music. Classical music?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「消し忘れ……？」
dialogues.en: "Forgot something...?"
dialogues.text: "Forgot something...?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、お帰り。──って、あら、朝倉も一緒
　なんだ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, welcome back. --Huh, with Asakura too."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, welcome back. --Huh, with Asakura too."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「んげ、先生？」
dialogues.en: "Guh, sensei?"
dialogues.text: "Guh, sensei?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なぁにが、んげ、よ」
dialogues.en: "What's with that "Guh"?"
dialogues.text: "What's with that "Guh"?"

dialogues.jp:
じとっと流し目をくれてくる。クラシック音楽
は、棚に載ったラジカセから流れているらしい。
dialogues.en:
I took a look around. The classical music was coming from a
radio casette player on a shelf.
dialogues.text:
I took a look around. The classical music was coming from a
radio casette player on a shelf.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごほっ……お姉ちゃん、どうしたの？」
dialogues.en: "*Cough*... Sis, why are you still here?"
dialogues.text: "*Cough*... Sis, why are you still here?"

dialogues.jp: ソファーに深く身を沈め、ことりが｛たず／訊｝ねた。
dialogues.en: Kotori sank onto the sofa while asking.
dialogues.text: Kotori sank onto the sofa while asking.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「うん、体調が悪そうだったからね。早退して
　くるんじゃないかと思ったの。それで、ね」
dialogues.en:
"Looking at you when you left, I knew you'd come back
early."
dialogues.text:
"Looking at you when you left, I knew you'd come back
early."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「へえ、優しいっすね」
dialogues.en: "Heh, how nice of you."
dialogues.text: "Heh, how nice of you."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「まあた。おだてたって成績は変わんないよ？」
dialogues.en: "Of course. No different from how I usually am, no?"
dialogues.text: "Of course. No different from how I usually am, no?"

dialogues.jp:
ぱたぱたと手を振る。と、ふざけていたような
顔が、一転して真面目なものになった。
dialogues.en:
She waved her hand jokingly. Then from her teasing face, she
made a 180 degree turn into a serious one.
dialogues.text:
She waved her hand jokingly. Then from her teasing face, she
made a 180 degree turn into a serious one.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「で？　どうして、朝倉が居るのかな？」
dialogues.en: "What about you? Why are you here?"
dialogues.text: "What about you? Why are you here?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「送ってきたんですよ。ちょっと、心配だった
　もので」
dialogues.en:
"I was making sure she got home safely. I'm worried too,
after all."
dialogues.text:
"I was making sure she got home safely. I'm worried too,
after all."

dialogues.jp:
ぎょろぎょろとメガネの向こうで目玉が器用に
動き、ことりへと向けられた。
dialogues.en:
From beyond her glasses, I could see her gaze shift from me
to her sister.
dialogues.text:
From beyond her glasses, I could see her gaze shift from me
to her sister.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「優しいよね、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun's really nice."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun's really nice."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「……最近、仲いいってもっぱらの噂だったけ
　ど、ほんとだったんだね」
dialogues.en:
"...I guess the rumours I've been hearing recently about you
two getting close are true."
dialogues.text:
"...I guess the rumours I've been hearing recently about you
two getting close are true."

dialogues.jp: 講師達にも知れ渡っていたのか。
dialogues.en: It's even well-known among the teaching staff now.
dialogues.text: It's even well-known among the teaching staff now.

dialogues.jp: 何というか──暦先生の視線が痛い。
dialogues.en: How to say it-- Koyomi-sensei's eyes seemed a bit pained.
dialogues.text: How to say it-- Koyomi-sensei's eyes seemed a bit pained.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それよりお姉ちゃん、曲止めて……クラシッ
　ク、やだ……」
dialogues.en:
"Both ways, could you turn off the music... I don't like
listening to classical..."
dialogues.text:
"Both ways, could you turn off the music... I don't like
listening to classical..."

dialogues.jp: けだるげにラジカセを指差す。
dialogues.en: She listlessly pointed to the casette player.
dialogues.text: She listlessly pointed to the casette player.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい」
dialogues.en: "Okay, okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay, okay."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生は口をへの字に曲げて、リモコンを手に
取った。途端に、部屋が静かになる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei disapprovingly switched off the casette player
using a remote control. The room instantly became silent.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei disapprovingly switched off the casette player
using a remote control. The room instantly became silent.

dialogues.jp: 「へえ、ことりってクラシックが嫌いなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh, Kotori doesn't like classical music?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, Kotori doesn't like classical music?"

dialogues.jp:
室内の妙な空気を変えようと、話題を振ってみ
る。
dialogues.en:
The mood in the room had turned weird, so I tried to start a
conversation to lift it.
dialogues.text:
The mood in the room had turned weird, so I tried to start a
conversation to lift it.

dialogues.jp: 「ことり？　……何だ、眠っちゃったのか」
dialogues.en: "Kotori? ....Wow, she fell asleep."
dialogues.text: "Kotori? ....Wow, she fell asleep."

dialogues.jp:
目をつむり、規則正しい呼吸を繰り返すことり
は、既に夢の中らしかった。
dialogues.en:
Her eyes closed and her breathing steady, Kotori had went
into the dream world.
dialogues.text:
Her eyes closed and her breathing steady, Kotori had went
into the dream world.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「やれやれ。ほんと、無理ばっかりする子なん
　だから」
dialogues.en: "Oh boy. She really overdoes things all the time."
dialogues.text: "Oh boy. She really overdoes things all the time."

dialogues.jp:
呆れたような口調。けれど、声に温かみを感じ
た。
dialogues.en:
It was a tone of some surprise, but the voice felt more warm
than insulting.
dialogues.text:
It was a tone of some surprise, but the voice felt more warm
than insulting.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ふむ、朝倉が居てちょうど良かったかな。起
　こさずに済むわね……」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, good thing you were here. She can sleep properly now."
dialogues.text: "Hmm, good thing you were here. She can sleep properly now."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「え？　何の話です？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? What are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp: 暦先生はにっと笑った。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei grinned at me.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei grinned at me.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「男の子だもん、力あるよねえ？」
dialogues.en: "Boys are supposed to be strong, aren't they?"
dialogues.text: "Boys are supposed to be strong, aren't they?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「おっと、手の動きはチェックするからね。変
　なとこ触ったら、ただじゃおかないよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, and watch where you put your hands. We wouldn't want
any "accidents" now, would we?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, and watch where you put your hands. We wouldn't want
any "accidents" now, would we?"

dialogues.jp: ◆ことり、ダウン◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori, Down◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori, Down◆

dialogues.jp:
一番乗りで音楽室に着いてしまった。自分自身、
その行動に意外さを覚えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Surprisingly enough, I was the first one to reach the music
room. That hasn't happened for as long as I remembered.
dialogues.text:
Surprisingly enough, I was the first one to reach the music
room. That hasn't happened for as long as I remembered.

dialogues.jp:
やって来たともちゃんとみっくんに、ことりと
付き合っているのかどうか｛き／訊｝かれてしまった。
今の所は、ただの友達でしかないが……。
dialogues.en:
When Tomo-chan and Mik-kun arrived, they asked whether
Kotori and I were dating. Right now, we're just normal
friends...
dialogues.text:
When Tomo-chan and Mik-kun arrived, they asked whether
Kotori and I were dating. Right now, we're just normal
friends...

dialogues.jp:
遅刻して、ことりがやって来た。どうも体調が
悪くて、それで来るのに時間が掛かってしまっ
たらしい。
dialogues.en:
After awhile, Kotori finally came. She was feeling even
worse than the days before, and had to struggle just to
reach here.
dialogues.text:
After awhile, Kotori finally came. She was feeling even
worse than the days before, and had to struggle just to
reach here.

dialogues.jp:
無理をするのは良くないと、俺はことりを家ま
で送る事にした。
dialogues.en:
We told her not to over do it, and I escorted Kotori back to
her house.
dialogues.text:
We told her not to over do it, and I escorted Kotori back to
her house.

dialogues.jp: 途中、工藤に出会ったりもして。
dialogues.en: On the way, we met Kudou.
dialogues.text: On the way, we met Kudou.

dialogues.jp: 家に着くと、暦先生が待っていた。
dialogues.en: At Kotori's house, Koyomi-sensei was waiting.
dialogues.text: At Kotori's house, Koyomi-sensei was waiting.
